{
  "doc": "retarded-scarcity-wake",
  "title": "The retarded-scarcity wake: moving gravity through a substrate",
  "status": "refuted",
  "families": [
    "retarded-scarcity-wake"
  ],
  "updated": "2026-09-04",
  "headline": "Delayed-center shortcut fails as a Poisson-vacuum field; the explicit boost-violating equation (Branch C) was written and closed — its dissipative parameter drags the Sun at a rate the ephemeris floor excludes. No observable galactic wake survives in the minimal local class.",
  "live_fronts": [],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "retarded-wake-potential-like-scalar",
      "family": "retarded-scarcity-wake",
      "kind": "model-property",
      "status": "supported",
      "claim": "A localized scarcity source has a potential-like scalar that increases numerically from the deep center toward the edge, while its gradient attracts matter inward",
      "evidence": "By construction in [scarcity-grid-weight-black-hole](../../../orrery/lab/sims/scarcity-grid-weight-black-hole/) and [scarcity-capped-cumulative-field](../../../orrery/lab/sims/scarcity-capped-cumulative-field/); inherited only as mechanics from [gravity-as-scarcity](../gravity-as-scarcity/), not as evidence that nature uses scarcity",
      "links": [
        "../../../orrery/lab/sims/scarcity-grid-weight-black-hole/",
        "../../../orrery/lab/sims/scarcity-capped-cumulative-field/",
        "../gravity-as-scarcity/"
      ],
      "in_doc_ledger": true
    },
    {
      "id": "retarded-wake-substrate-u-exists",
      "family": "retarded-scarcity-wake",
      "kind": "nature",
      "status": "conjecture",
      "claim": "There exists a physical gravitational substrate with a locally meaningful velocity field **U**, distinct in principle from the CMB frame",
      "evidence": "Moot: Branch C closed (ORB-11175). No source law or direct evidence; an O(1) substance coupling to a preferred frame is already bounded by [lorentz-violation-bounds](../../studies/lorentz-violation-bounds.md); an excitation-medium reading can hide uniform motion at leading order ([river-model-and-analog-gravity](../../studies/river-model-and-analog-gravity.md)). The minimal gravitational-sector coupling to such a U — an aether-frame dissipation — is now bounded to \\(\\ell_\\Gamma>10\\)–\\(100\\) kpc by the solar-system drag it implies ([Branch C](../moving-source-field-consistency/branch-c.md)); whether U exists with no gravitational coupling at all is a question this family no longer asks",
      "links": [
        "../../studies/lorentz-violation-bounds.md",
        "../../studies/river-model-and-analog-gravity.md",
        "../moving-source-field-consistency/branch-c.md"
      ],
      "in_doc_ledger": true,
      "tags": [
        "preferred-frame"
      ],
      "comparator": "Lorentz-violation bounds and analog-gravity hiding of uniform motion, not an O(1) aether wind."
    },
    {
      "id": "retarded-wake-delayed-center-dipole",
      "family": "retarded-scarcity-wake",
      "kind": "derived",
      "status": "untested",
      "claim": "Under the delayed-center postulate, uniform translation produces a first-order potential dipole proportional to \\(v/c_g\\), with higher conventional potential on the leading edge and stronger attraction on the trailing edge",
      "evidence": "The algebra is internally consistent, but \\(\\Phi_{\\rm lag}\\) is not the compact-source exterior solution of the standard Poisson equation: it has \\(\\nabla^2\\Phi\\neq0\\) outside the galaxy and a linearly divergent Poisson-equivalent dipole moment. The analytic check awaits a cataloged negative-control fixture — [moving-source-field-consistency](../moving-source-field-consistency/)",
      "links": [
        "../moving-source-field-consistency/"
      ],
      "in_doc_ledger": true,
      "kill": "Cataloged negative-control fixture confirms Laplace-forbidden n≥1 terms and the linearly divergent dipole."
    },
    {
      "id": "retarded-wake-4beta-contrast",
      "family": "retarded-scarcity-wake",
      "kind": "derived",
      "status": "untested",
      "claim": "The first-order acceleration contrast is \\((g_{\\rm trail}-g_{\\rm lead})/g_0\\simeq4\\beta_g\\)",
      "evidence": "Analytically corrected to \\(2\\beta_g\\) in § Leading/trailing sign. \\(4\\beta_g\\) follows from a *different*, non-potential force rule than the declared \\(\\mathbf{a}=-\\nabla\\Phi\\); the fixture remains to be cataloged — [moving-source-field-consistency](../moving-source-field-consistency/)",
      "links": [
        "../moving-source-field-consistency/"
      ],
      "in_doc_ledger": true,
      "kill": "Cataloged fixture: declared a=−∇Φ gives 2β_g, not 4β_g."
    },
    {
      "id": "retarded-wake-retarded-direction-conservative",
      "family": "retarded-scarcity-wake",
      "kind": "derived",
      "status": "untested",
      "claim": "The alternative \"force points toward the retarded position\" rule is a legitimate conservative mechanic",
      "evidence": "Analytically it has nonzero curl and admits loop-dependent work \\(\\sim\\beta_g GM/R\\); constant-\\(R\\) circles return zero, so the fixture must vary eccentricity and apsidal orientation — [moving-source-field-consistency](../moving-source-field-consistency/)",
      "links": [
        "../moving-source-field-consistency/"
      ],
      "in_doc_ledger": true,
      "kill": "Cataloged fixture: nonzero curl and loop-dependent work."
    },
    {
      "id": "retarded-wake-concentration",
      "family": "retarded-scarcity-wake",
      "kind": "nature",
      "status": "refuted",
      "claim": "A centrally concentrated galaxy preserves a larger coherent wake than a diffuse distribution with the same total mass",
      "evidence": "Moot for the rejected delayed-center shortcut, and false for the explicit Branch C equation: at first order the exterior dipole of the dissipative term is set by the far field of the Newtonian potential, i.e. by total mass alone, so \\(A_1(r)\\to\\beta_g r/2\\ell_\\Gamma\\) independent of central concentration up to \\(O(a/r)\\); the source-delay term is a rigid shift of the whole potential, likewise concentration-blind — [Branch C](../moving-source-field-consistency/branch-c.md) § The first-order moving-source solution (ORB-11175)",
      "links": [
        "../moving-source-field-consistency/branch-c.md"
      ],
      "in_doc_ledger": true,
      "kill": "Fired: the minimal Branch C amplitude is concentration-independent."
    },
    {
      "id": "retarded-wake-m1-asymmetry",
      "family": "retarded-scarcity-wake",
      "kind": "nature",
      "status": "refuted",
      "claim": "The wake displaces the dynamical center behind the baryonic center and produces an \\(m=1\\) leading/trailing rotation asymmetry rather than an axisymmetric flat-curve boost",
      "evidence": "Refuted on both counts by the explicit equation (ORB-11175, [Branch C](../moving-source-field-consistency/branch-c.md)): the dissipative solution's first-order leading/trailing *radial* contrast vanishes (the first-order force is tangential, \\(g_0A_1\\sin\\theta\\), zero on the leading/trailing axis), and the amplitude itself is capped by the solar-system self-acceleration wall at \\(A_1(10\\,{\\rm kpc})\\lesssim10^{-3}\\)–\\(3\\times10^{-5}\\), two to three orders below observed lopsidedness ([solar-system-ephemeris-precision-floor](../../studies/solar-system-ephemeris-precision-floor.md)). The source-delay term displaces the centre, but by a fixed \\(\\lvert\\tau_s\\rvert w<R_\\odot\\), unobservable at galactic radii",
      "links": [
        "../moving-source-field-consistency/branch-c.md",
        "../../studies/solar-system-ephemeris-precision-floor.md"
      ],
      "in_doc_ledger": true,
      "kill": "Fired: no first-order radial contrast in the minimal class, and the amplitude is bounded below observability."
    },
    {
      "id": "retarded-wake-axis-velocity-correlation",
      "family": "retarded-scarcity-wake",
      "kind": "nature",
      "status": "untested",
      "claim": "A correlation between observed asymmetry axes and a common inferred substrate velocity would be evidence for the wake (§ Observable signatures, last bullet; rejection gate 6)",
      "evidence": "Moot: Branch C closed (ORB-11175). The conditional stands as logic, but no surviving model predicts an amplitude above \\(10^{-3}\\), and the cosmological baseline it would have needed — the leading tidal tensor is quadrupolar and does not by itself establish an \\(m=1\\) phase correlation ([moving-source-field-consistency](../moving-source-field-consistency/) § A degeneracy to measure, not assume) — is no longer owed by this family",
      "links": [
        "../moving-source-field-consistency/",
        "../moving-source-field-consistency/branch-c.md"
      ],
      "in_doc_ledger": true,
      "kill": "Moot: Branch C closed. Reopening needs daniel_reopen and an amplitude above the ephemeris ceiling."
    },
    {
      "id": "retarded-wake-lopsidedness-warp-split",
      "family": "retarded-scarcity-wake",
      "kind": "nature",
      "status": "untested",
      "claim": "A boost-violating model may produce a lopsidedness-versus-vertical-distortion split set partly by the angle between \\(\\mathbf{w}\\) and the disk normal",
      "evidence": "Moot: Branch C closed (ORB-11175). In the minimal equation the split exists in form — in-plane \\(\\mathbf{w}\\) gives the tangential \\(m=1\\) force, perpendicular \\(\\mathbf{w}\\) a \\(1/R\\) midplane vertical acceleration (bowl-like, not an integral-sign warp) — at amplitudes the ephemeris floor caps below \\(10^{-3}\\) ([Branch C](../moving-source-field-consistency/branch-c.md))",
      "links": [
        "../moving-source-field-consistency/branch-c.md"
      ],
      "in_doc_ledger": true,
      "kill": "Moot: Branch C closed. Reopening needs daniel_reopen and an amplitude above the ephemeris ceiling."
    },
    {
      "id": "retarded-wake-boost-invariant-cancel",
      "family": "retarded-scarcity-wake",
      "kind": "nature",
      "status": "supported",
      "claim": "A specified boost-invariant causal field can cancel the delayed-center model's first-order dipole while retaining finite propagation speed",
      "evidence": "Previously conjecture pending the local study note; supported 2026-08-28 by [moving-source-gravity-bounds](../../studies/moving-source-gravity-bounds.md) § aberration cancellation (Heaviside/Liénard–Wiechert exact for uniform motion; Carlip 2000 through \\(O((v/c)^5)\\) radiation-reaction order in general relativity), and reproduced inside the Branch C equation with its time-odd sector off — the Heaviside form, even in \\(\\xi_\\parallel\\) at every order in \\(\\beta_g\\) for every \\(c_g\\) ([Branch C](../moving-source-field-consistency/branch-c.md) § The control). A calibration result for specified equations, not a verdict on every preferred-medium equation — which is why Branch C had to be written",
      "links": [
        "../../studies/moving-source-gravity-bounds.md",
        "../moving-source-field-consistency/branch-c.md"
      ],
      "in_doc_ledger": true
    },
    {
      "id": "retarded-wake-gravitational-cone",
      "family": "retarded-scarcity-wake",
      "kind": "nature",
      "status": "refuted",
      "claim": "A gravitational cone forms when \\(v>c_g\\)",
      "evidence": "Previously conjecture while an extra substrate mode's coupling was unspecified; refuted for this wake's field once the sourced wall and Branch C fixed that scope. GW170817 pins the observed tensor speed near \\(c\\) ([scalar-gravity-ppn-constraints](../../studies/scalar-gravity-ppn-constraints.md)) and Moore & Nelson give Cherenkov bounds of \\(c-c_g<2\\times10^{-15}c\\) (Galactic) and ~\\(2\\times10^{-19}c\\) (extragalactic) for any conventionally coupled mode ([moving-source-gravity-bounds](../../studies/moving-source-gravity-bounds.md) § gravitational Cherenkov). The escape through an extra, differently coupled substrate mode closed with Branch C: its potential is the conventionally coupled one ([Branch C](../moving-source-field-consistency/branch-c.md) § Walls). Galaxies at \\(10^{-3}c\\) never outrun the field",
      "links": [
        "../../studies/scalar-gravity-ppn-constraints.md",
        "../../studies/moving-source-gravity-bounds.md",
        "../moving-source-field-consistency/branch-c.md"
      ],
      "in_doc_ledger": true
    },
    {
      "id": "retarded-wake-rescues-parent",
      "family": "retarded-scarcity-wake",
      "kind": "nature",
      "status": "refuted",
      "claim": "The new velocity-dependent branch rescues the parent scarcity theory's fixed-β galactic law, photon sector, or source-law debt",
      "evidence": "It does not address those failures. The parent ledger remains controlling: [gravity-as-scarcity](../gravity-as-scarcity/)",
      "links": [
        "../gravity-as-scarcity/"
      ],
      "in_doc_ledger": true
    }
  ]
}
